creators.name: Shunichi Kasahara
creators.role: Researcher, Sony Computer Science Laboratories; leads Cybernetic Humanity Studio (OIST)
creators.bio: Sony CSL researcher who builds perception-bending systems: first-person view sharing (JackIn), out-of-body telepresence, EMS-accelerated reactions and real-time face morphing. Earlier co-created exTouch and Second Surface at the MIT Media Lab.
creators.why: He treats AR as 'Superception' - engineering the sense of self by swapping, splitting and delaying what you see and do.

creators.name: Ivan Poupyrev
creators.role: Interaction scientist; Sony CSL, Disney Research, Google ATAP (Soli, Jacquard); CEO of Archetype AI
creators.bio: Built early tangible AR at Sony CSL and HIT Lab, then turned everyday matter into interfaces at Disney Research (Touché, Botanicus Interacticus, Ishin-Den-Shin) and Google ATAP (Soli radar, Jacquard textiles).
creators.why: He makes the physical world itself the input surface - plants, water, skin, fabric and air become sensors for mixed reality.

creators.name: Ken Nakagaki
creators.role: Assistant Professor, University of Chicago; directs the Actuated Experience Lab (AxLab)
creators.bio: Former MIT Tangible Media researcher who builds shape-changing lines, robot swarms and mechanical shells that make digital information physically move around people.
creators.why: His actuated tangibles are the physical twin of AR: instead of overlaying pixels, the room's objects reshape and move themselves.

creators.name: Yuta Itoh
creators.role: Associate Professor, University of Tokyo (Augmented Vision Lab); formerly Tokyo Tech and TU Munich
creators.bio: Researches optical see-through displays that do more than add graphics: they subtract light, fix eyesight and show the future path of moving objects.
creators.why: He reframes AR glasses as 'vision augmentation' - hardware that rewrites the light reaching your eye.

creators.name: Pedro Lopes
creators.role: Associate Professor, University of Chicago; directs the Human Computer Integration Lab
creators.bio: Builds interfaces that actuate the user's own body - electrical muscle stimulation, chemical and thermal haptics - to give mixed reality physical weight and to let objects 'tell' your hands how to use them.
creators.why: He turned the human body into the output device of AR: your muscles feel the virtual wall.

creators.name: Michael Nebeling
creators.role: Associate Professor, University of Michigan School of Information; Information Interaction Lab
creators.bio: Creates rapid prototyping tools that let non-programmers make AR/VR from paper, Play-Doh and video (ProtoAR, 360proto, XRDirector).
creators.why: He democratised AR design: sketches on paper become working AR prototypes in minutes.

creators.name: Lightform (Brett Jones & Kevin Karsch)
creators.role: Projected-AR hardware/software startup; Brett Jones was lead author of IllumiRoom and RoomAlive
creators.bio: Lightform built the LF1/LF2 projector-camera units and Lightform Creator so anyone could scan a scene and projection-map it in minutes.
creators.why: Turned research-grade projector-camera AR (IllumiRoom, RoomAlive) into a consumer tool for 'projected AR' murals and objects.

creators.name: Rajinder Sodhi
creators.role: HCI researcher (UIUC PhD); worked at Microsoft Research, Disney Research and Qualcomm on projected and haptic AR
creators.bio: Co-created LightGuide (projected hand-movement guidance), BeThere (3D mobile telepresence with spatial input) and Disney's AIREAL air-vortex haptics.
creators.why: LightGuide is one of the clearest demonstrations that AR can guide the body by drawing directly on the hand.

creators.name: Autodesk Research (Fraser Anderson, Tovi Grossman, George Fitzmaurice et al.)
creators.role: Corporate HCI research group
creators.bio: Autodesk's UI research group builds AR tools for making and learning: projected pen overlays, AR movement mirrors, assembly-tutorial authoring and two-way MR remote instruction.
creators.why: A decade of practical, craft-centred AR interaction ideas (YouMove, PenLight, AuthAR, Loki) that map directly onto teaching.

creators.name: Madeline Gannon
creators.role: Artist-roboticist; principal of ATONATON
creators.bio: Designs ways for people to communicate with machines - from projection-mapped on-skin 3D modelling (Tactum) to industrial robots that watch and follow visitors (Mimus).
creators.why: Tactum made your own forearm the canvas and controller for designing wearables in projected AR.

creators.name: Denis Kalkofen
creators.role: Associate Professor, Flinders University; formerly Graz University of Technology (ICG)
creators.bio: Specialist in AR visualization: X-ray and ghosted views of hidden structure, compact labels, and retargeting manuals and video tutorials into 3D AR instructions.
creators.why: He solved how AR should show what is inside or behind real objects without confusing depth.

creators.name: Magic Leap Studios
creators.role: In-house content studio of Magic Leap
creators.bio: Produced Magic Leap's showcase spatial experiences - the 2015 gym-whale concept, Create, Dodge, Mica and Undersea - to show content that respects real room geometry.
creators.why: Their demos defined the vocabulary of headset MR: creatures that know your furniture, digital humans that share your table.

creators.name: ILMxLAB (Lucasfilm)
creators.role: Lucasfilm's immersive entertainment studio
creators.bio: ILM's immersive lab made Star Wars mixed-reality experiments with Magic Leap, from the 2016 'Lost Droids' test to Project Porg.
creators.why: Showed how beloved characters can inhabit your real living room and respond to you.

creators.name: Microsoft HoloLens team (Alex Kipman, Kudo Tsunoda & Microsoft Studios)
creators.role: Platform team and first-party studio for HoloLens
creators.bio: Shipped the first self-contained holographic computer and its launch apps - RoboRaid, HoloStudio and the Minecraft tabletop demo.
creators.why: Established gaze + air-tap + voice as the grammar of headset AR and made spatial mapping playable.

creators.name: Meta Reality Labs (Quest mixed reality)
creators.role: Platform team behind Quest Presence Platform showcases
creators.bio: Built the Presence Platform showcases The World Beyond and First Encounters that teach Quest users what passthrough MR can do.
creators.why: First Encounters' punch-through-your-wall moment is the canonical demo of scene-aware passthrough MR.

creators.name: Apple (ARKit / visionOS teams)
creators.role: Platform company
creators.bio: Apple's ARKit and visionOS teams released SwiftShot, the first multi-user ARKit sample game, and the Vision Pro showcase Encounter Dinosaurs.
creators.why: Their showcases set expectations for shared tabletop AR and for creatures that notice you in spatial computing.

creators.name: Figmin XR (Overlay)
creators.role: Independent team behind the mixed-reality creation app Figmin XR
creators.bio: Figmin XR is a HoloLens-born, now Quest/Vision Pro app where you sketch, collect and script 3D objects that live and collide with your real room.
creators.why: It is a pocket 'mixed-reality sandbox': paint, physics, AI-scripted characters and room geometry in one tool.

creators.name: Danlin Huang
creators.role: Designer-researcher; China Academy of Art School of Design Innovation
creators.bio: Designs speculative mixed-reality rituals and tools - shared mushroom-mask MR, body-posture oracle glyphs, AR origami tutoring - often with Botao Amber Hu.
creators.why: Her work turns MR headsets into props for collective ritual and embodied speculation rather than screens.

creators.name: Owlchemy Labs
creators.role: VR/MR studio (Job Simulator), owned by Google
creators.bio: Makers of Job Simulator and Vacation Simulator, now leading hand-tracking design research and mixed-reality play on Android XR.
creators.why: Known for the most physical, comedic hand interactions in XR, now carried into passthrough MR.

creators.name: Cyborn
creators.role: Belgian VR/MR game studio
creators.bio: Creators of Hubris and the Quest 3 mixed-reality town builder Wall Town Wonders.
creators.why: Wall Town Wonders turns ordinary room walls into a living miniature city - a vertical-surface MR idea few others explored.

creators.name: Vitukhin Serhii
creators.role: Unity/AR developer; early HoloKit community developer
creators.bio: Built some of the first HoloKit + ARKit stereo demos in 2017, including a co-located multiplayer drone shooter shown at SIGGRAPH 2017.
creators.why: Early proof that a cardboard phone headset could host shared, co-located stereo AR games.

works.title: exTouch
works.description: Point a tablet at a small robot and drag its on-screen AR image with your finger; the real robot drives and rotates to match the gesture in physical space.
works.idea_zh: 在手机AR画面里拖动物体，现实中的机器人就跟着动：AR画面变成实体遥控器。
works.technique: Tracks the robot's pose with the tablet camera and converts touch-drag gestures on its AR image into motor commands in the robot's own coordinate frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR识别一个遥控小车上的图片标记，在屏幕上拖动虚拟箭头来驱动实体小车（可用Arduino/蓝牙车）；变化：让两位同学各用一部手机从不同角度同时操控同一辆车。

works.title: JackIn Eye
works.description: A remote viewer 'jacks into' a walking person's head-mounted camera; the system stitches past frames into an out-of-body third-person view so the viewer can look around beyond the wearer's gaze.
works.idea_zh: 远程的人“钻进”别人的第一人称视角，还能跳出身体从背后看他。
works.technique: Uses SLAM on the first-person video to register frames into a growing 3D panorama, then renders a virtual camera placed behind and above the wearer.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机直播一个同学的第一人称视角给另一位戴Cardboard的同学看，由观看者口头指挥他完成找物任务；变化：观看者只能看到5秒前的延迟画面。

works.title: JackIn Head
works.description: A head-worn omnidirectional camera streams stabilized 360-degree video so remote viewers can look anywhere around the wearer, independent of where the wearer turns their head.
works.idea_zh: 把别人头上的全景相机当作自己的眼睛，远程的人可以独立转头看四周。
works.technique: Estimates head rotation from the spherical video and counter-rotates each frame so the 360 stream stays world-stable for remote HMD viewers.
works.exercise_zh: 把一台360相机绑在帽子上直播到另一位同学的手机VR眼镜中，观看者用手势指挥佩戴者走路；变化：让三个人同时“附身”同一个人，投票决定方向。

works.title: Parallel Eyes
works.description: Four people wear HMDs showing a split screen of everyone's first-person views at once, then try to play hide-and-seek and coordinate while seeing through all bodies simultaneously.
works.idea_zh: 四个人同时看到彼此的第一人称视角，在“共享眼睛”里玩捉迷藏。
works.technique: Streams each participant's head-mounted camera into a shared tiled video layout shown in every HMD, a collaboration with YCAM.
works.exercise_zh: 让四名同学各用手机前摄/后摄开视频会议并把画面并排显示，戴着手机眼镜玩找人游戏；变化：随机把你的画面和别人的画面互换位置。

works.title: HeadLight
works.description: A head-mounted projector with a fish-eye lens throws a very wide image onto the surroundings in front of the wearer, augmenting whatever the wearer faces without glasses.
works.idea_zh: 把投影仪戴在头上，眼前的整个空间就是屏幕。
works.technique: Pre-distorts the image to compensate for the fish-eye conversion lens and aligns it with head orientation so graphics land on the walls the wearer looks at.
works.exercise_zh: 用胶带把手机投影仪（或手机+镜子）固定在头盔上，让投影内容跟随视线出现在墙上；变化：投影内容是只有你转头时才会显现的“隐藏标记”。

works.title: Fragment Shadow
works.description: Visitors' real shadows are split into several colored, offset shadows by precisely calibrated multiple projectors, so one body casts a fragmented, prismatic shadow.
works.idea_zh: 多台投影机让一个人的影子碎裂成好几个彩色影子。
works.technique: Calibrates several projectors' geometry and color so their overlapping light sums to white, making each body occlusion reveal a different colored shadow.
works.exercise_zh: 用三盏红绿蓝LED灯（或三台手机手电加彩色玻璃纸）从不同角度照向白墙，让同学用身体做出彩色影子；变化：用编程让每盏灯随音乐轮流闪烁。

works.title: Preemptive Action
works.description: Electrical muscle stimulation fires the user's arm a few milliseconds before they would react to a stimulus, speeding reaction time while the user still feels they moved by themselves.
works.idea_zh: 电刺激在你反应之前替你动手，但你仍觉得是自己动的。
works.technique: Triggers EMS at a tuned latency just before the user's natural reaction, finding the window where the action is faster yet still judged as self-caused.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机做一个“看到信号就拍桌”的反应小游戏，并让同伴在你身后用轻拍肩膀提前提示；变化：比较提示和不提示时你是否觉得“是自己做的”。

works.title: Stealth Updates
works.description: Visual content changes in front of the viewer without being noticed, by morphing images gradually and timing changes to exploit change blindness.
works.idea_zh: 利用“变化盲视”，让画面在你眼前改变却察觉不到。
works.technique: Computes a smooth image morph between old and new content and plays it slowly enough to stay below the threshold of noticed change.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR把一张海报上的元素用30秒慢慢变换成另一张图，让同学盯着看并报告是否发现变化；变化：在对方眨眼或转头时再快速切换。

works.title: Parallel Ping-Pong
works.description: One user in VR controls two robot arms playing table tennis at two tables simultaneously, switching perspective between bodies to hit both balls.
works.idea_zh: 一个人同时操控两个身体打两场乒乓球。
works.technique: Streams two robot-mounted camera views into an HMD and maps the user's single arm motion to whichever robot body is currently selected or blended.
works.exercise_zh: 用两部手机分别拍两个桌面小游戏，把画面并排投到一块屏幕上，让一名同学同时用双手远程指挥两位“替身”同学；变化：两个画面每10秒左右对调。

works.title: Morphing Identity
works.description: Two people face a screen where their live faces gradually morph into each other in real time, exploring where 'self' ends and 'other' begins.
works.idea_zh: 实时把你的脸慢慢变成对面那个人的脸。
works.technique: Tracks facial landmarks on both live video feeds and warps and cross-dissolves the textures with a controllable blend ratio.
works.exercise_zh: 用Snap Lens Studio或Effect House做一个把自己脸与同桌脸按滑块比例融合的滤镜；变化：融合比例由两人说话音量决定。

works.title: ShadowClones
works.description: A single user controls several virtual bodies seen from multiple viewpoints; shadow-like cues keep track of where each body is so they can coordinate actions across perspectives.
works.idea_zh: 一个人分身成多个影子般的身体，并在多视角中协调它们。
works.technique: Renders several avatar copies driven by one tracked body and overlays shadow projections of each clone to preserve body-space coordination across views.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机AR中放置三个会复制你动作的虚拟分身（用人体骨骼追踪），让你摆姿势让三个分身同时拍到目标；变化：每个分身动作延迟不同。

works.title: TeslaTouch
works.description: A touch screen that produces variable friction under a sliding finger using electrovibration, so flat images can feel rough, bumpy or sticky.
works.idea_zh: 让平板屏幕表面摸起来有纹理。
works.technique: Applies a modulated high voltage to an insulated electrode so electrostatic attraction changes skin friction as the finger moves.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机振动API做一个“触觉纹理”画板：手指滑过不同颜色区域时产生不同节奏的振动；变化：让同伴闭眼只凭触感猜出图案。

works.title: Touché
works.description: Swept-frequency capacitive sensing that recognises how you touch a doorknob, a table, water or your own body - one pinch versus full grasp - with a single electrode.
works.idea_zh: 一根电极就能分辨你是捏、握还是整只手浸在水里。
works.technique: Sweeps the excitation frequency across a range and classifies the resulting capacitive profile, because different grips change the body's impedance at different frequencies.
works.exercise_zh: 用Makey Makey或Arduino的电容触摸引脚连接水杯、水果或门把手，训练一个简单分类器识别“摸一下/握住”；变化：把不同握法映射成手机AR里不同的特效。

works.title: Botanicus Interacticus
works.description: Living plants become interactive: stroking, pinching or sliding along a stem is sensed through the plant itself and triggers projected visuals and sound.
works.idea_zh: 抚摸一株真植物，它会发出声音和光影。
works.technique: Places a single electrode in the plant's soil and applies Touché-style swept-frequency sensing to locate and classify touches on the plant.
works.exercise_zh: 把盆栽接到Makey Makey或触摸传感器上，触摸叶片时在手机或投影上长出虚拟花朵并发声；变化：两人同时触摸时才会开花。

works.title: Ishin-Den-Shin
works.description: A person speaks into a microphone and then touches someone's ear with a finger; the recorded message is heard only by the person being touched, transmitted through the body.
works.idea_zh: 用手指触碰对方耳朵，悄悄话通过身体传过去。
works.technique: Converts recorded speech into a modulated inaudible high-voltage signal on the speaker's body, and the touched earlobe vibrates as a tiny speaker.
works.exercise_zh: 用骨传导耳机或手机录音，设计“只有被触碰的人才能听到”的传声游戏（碰肩触发播放）；变化：信息沿一条人链逐个传递并逐渐变形。

works.title: Project Soli
works.description: A tiny radar chip senses sub-millimetre finger motions in the air, so rubbing fingers turns a virtual dial and tapping presses an invisible button.
works.idea_zh: 用手指在空中搓一搓就能转动看不见的旋钮。
works.technique: Emits a broad radar beam and classifies the Doppler and range signature of micro-finger movements into 'virtual tool' gestures.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手部追踪或MediaPipe实现“捏合转旋钮、双指点按钮”的空中微手势控制一个虚拟收音机；变化：只允许眼睛不看手完成操作。

works.title: Project Jacquard
works.description: Conductive yarns woven into ordinary fabric turn a jacket sleeve into a touch surface: swipe or tap the cuff to control your phone.
works.idea_zh: 把衣袖织成触摸板。
works.technique: Weaves a grid of conductive threads into the textile and reads capacitive changes from a snap-on tag that classifies swipes and taps.
works.exercise_zh: 用导电胶带或导电线缝在旧手套/袖子上，接Makey Makey控制手机AR里的场景切换；变化：不同的衣服部位代表不同的AR“魔法”。

works.title: LineFORM
works.description: A snake-like chain of servo modules that can bend into shapes, wrap the wrist, act as a physical graph line, or constrain the user's hand motion.
works.idea_zh: 一条会自己弯曲的“线”，既能显示信息又能约束你的手。
works.technique: Chains serially linked servo segments and computes joint angles by inverse kinematics so the line can take on target curves or respond to touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用吸管和扭扭棒做一条可弯曲的实体线，再用手机AR沿着线显示流动的数据或音乐波形；变化：同学改变线的形状时AR内容同步变化。

works.title: ChainFORM
works.description: Modular chains with built-in touch sensing, angle sensing and LEDs that can be snapped together into shape-changing strips, wearables or creatures.
works.idea_zh: 可拼接的智能链条，能感触、显示和变形。
works.technique: Each module carries a servo, angle sensor, capacitive touch pad and LED on a shared bus, so a chain can both record and replay its own shape.
works.exercise_zh: 用积木或纸链条做一个“会记录形状”的原型，同时用手机AR给每一节标上颜色和数值；变化：把链条缠在手腕上变成可穿戴提醒器。

works.title: AnimaStage
works.description: A tabletop stage with a hidden grid of actuators animates paper crafts and 3D-printed figures placed on it, turning hand-made props into puppets.
works.idea_zh: 在一个会动的舞台上，把纸片和手工道具变成会动的木偶。
works.technique: Drives an array of linear actuators under a flexible stage surface so objects attached to it are pushed, tilted and bounced to perform scripted motions.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板和手机振动（或小电机）做一个会抖动的纸偶舞台，并用手机AR叠加表情与台词；变化：让观众拍手的节奏驱动舞台动作。

works.title: HERMITS
works.description: Small self-propelled robots dock into interchangeable mechanical shells - a lever, a crank, a vehicle - gaining new physical interactions like hermit crabs changing shells.
works.idea_zh: 像寄居蟹换壳一样，小机器人钻进不同外壳就获得新功能。
works.technique: Uses toio robots with position tracking to drive into passive 3D-printed shells whose gears and levers convert robot motion into new actuation or input.
works.exercise_zh: 给一个遥控小车设计三种纸板“外壳”（推土铲、旗帜、小屋），用手机AR标注每个外壳的功能；变化：让小车根据二维码自动识别换上的外壳。

works.title: Buoyancé
works.description: Mobile robots reel helium balloons up and down by strings, forming floating 3D displays and interactive mid-air objects above a tabletop.
works.idea_zh: 机器人拉着氦气球升降，在空中形成可交互的立体显示。
works.technique: Each tabletop robot winds a tether to set balloon height while driving to set x-y position, so a swarm places floating points in 3D space.
works.exercise_zh: 用气球、线和手动升降把桌面变成空中柱状图，再用手机AR给每个气球叠加标签；变化：同学拉动气球改变高度，AR中的数据随之更新。

works.title: Shape n' Swarm
works.description: Users sculpt a shape with their hands and describe it in speech; an LLM plans how a swarm of small tabletop robots should arrange and move to represent and animate it.
works.idea_zh: 用手比划加一句话，机器人群就排出并动起你想要的形状。
works.technique: Combines hand-sketched shape input with an LLM that outputs robot target positions and motion scripts for a swarm UI.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学用语音描述一个动物，由ChatGPT生成一组坐标，再由几名同学手持纸片按坐标在地面上排出这个形状；变化：要求形状“动起来”（如鸟扇动翅膀）。

works.title: OST Rift
works.description: A consumer VR headset converted into an optical see-through AR display with careful timing so virtual objects stay locked to the real world during head motion.
works.idea_zh: 把VR头显改装成光学透视AR，让虚拟物体稳稳“钉”在现实中。
works.technique: Adds beam-splitter optics to a Rift and predicts head pose to compensate display latency, keeping overlays temporally consistent with the real scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用HoloKit或手机+半透镜做一个简易透视AR眼镜，比较快速转头时虚拟方块的漂移；变化：人为加入200ms延迟，让同学描述感受。

works.title: Laplacian Vision
works.description: AR glasses or a projector show the predicted future trajectory of a thrown ball as a line in the air, helping people anticipate and catch it.
works.idea_zh: 让你看到飞行物体未来的轨迹。
works.technique: Tracks the object with cameras, fits a ballistic model and renders the extrapolated path in the user's view with latency compensation.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测一个滚动的球并用抛物线/直线外推画出它未来1秒的位置；变化：故意显示“错误的未来”看同学是否被误导。

works.title: AdaptiVisor
works.description: An occlusion-capable see-through HMD selectively dims bright regions of the real world, like a sun visor per pixel, to help the eye adapt to glare.
works.idea_zh: 像素级墨镜：只把刺眼的那部分现实调暗。
works.technique: Uses a camera to find over-bright regions and an LCD panel in the optical path to attenuate exactly those pixels of real-world light.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头实时检测画面中最亮的区域并在视频透视中把它涂暗，做一个“智能防眩”滤镜；变化：反过来只保留最亮区域、其余全部变暗。

works.title: Occlusion Leak Compensation
works.description: A see-through display that can make virtual objects truly opaque by blocking real light, and compensates the blurry 'leak' around the mask so edges look sharp.
works.idea_zh: 让透视AR里的虚拟物体真正挡住后面的现实。
works.technique: Predicts the defocus blur of the occlusion mask and adds compensating light from the display so the combined image has crisp opaque edges.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机视频透视AR对比“半透明叠加”和“完全遮挡”两种虚拟物体渲染，观察哪种更像真的；变化：给虚拟物体加阴影后再比较。

works.title: Varifocal Occlusion
works.description: An optical see-through HMD whose occlusion mask can be moved in focal depth, so real objects are blocked correctly whether they are near or far.
works.idea_zh: 遮挡层可以前后对焦，远近的现实都能被正确遮住。
works.technique: Slides the occlusion SLM along the optical axis so the mask's focal plane matches the depth of the real object being blocked.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机相机拍摄近处与远处两个物体，分别在对焦于近/远时叠加虚拟遮挡片，讨论为何会模糊；变化：用手动对焦App演示焦平面变化。

works.title: Affordance++
works.description: Objects 'tell' the user how to use them by actuating the user's own hand with EMS: grabbing a spray can makes you shake it, touching a hot mug makes your hand pull back.
works.idea_zh: 物体通过电刺激直接“教”你的手怎么用它。
works.technique: Detects which object the hand approaches and plays a pre-recorded EMS pattern on forearm muscles that enacts the object's intended movement.
works.exercise_zh: 给教室里的几个物品贴二维码，用手机AR识别后在手上叠加“动态使用提示”（如抖动、旋转箭头）；变化：提示用手机振动节奏而非图像表示。

works.title: Impacto
works.description: A wearable combining a tactile solenoid tap with EMS muscle contraction so virtual boxing punches and soccer headers feel like real impacts.
works.idea_zh: 让VR里的一拳真的打到你身上。
works.technique: Pairs a solenoid for the skin-level tap with EMS that jerks the limb backwards, together simulating the momentum of an impact.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机AR拳击游戏，被打中时同伴用泡沫棒轻拍你手臂（“人肉触觉”）；变化：比较有/无触觉时玩家的躲闪反应。

works.title: Force Feedback for Mixed Reality via EMS
works.description: On HoloLens, virtual buttons, walls and heavy objects push back: EMS on the user's arm muscles creates resistance so the user feels them without holding any device.
works.idea_zh: 在HoloLens里按虚拟按钮、推虚拟墙，手臂真的感到阻力。
works.technique: Detects hand contact with virtual objects and stimulates antagonist muscles to create counter-force while leaving the hands free to touch real objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机AR里放置一面虚拟墙，当手机穿过墙时让手机持续强振动并变红来表示“阻力”；变化：用弹力带绑住手臂模拟推墙的真实阻力。

works.title: Touch&Fold
works.description: A nail-mounted actuator unfolds a small pad onto the fingertip only when touching virtual objects, and folds away so the finger can feel real objects normally.
works.idea_zh: 指尖触觉器需要时展开、不需要时收起，虚实都能摸。
works.technique: Mounts a servo-driven folding tactor on the fingernail that rotates onto the pad for virtual contact and retracts for real-world touch.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个指套纸片装置：碰到手机AR中的虚拟物体时由同伴翻下纸片到指腹，碰真实物体时翻起；变化：纸片换成不同材质代表不同虚拟物。

works.title: Altering Perceived Softness of Real Rigid Objects
works.description: A thin device restricts how the fingerpad deforms, so pressing a hard real object feels softer or harder than it is, useful for MR props.
works.idea_zh: 改变指腹变形，让硬桌子摸起来变软。
works.technique: Constrains lateral fingerpad spread with a rigid ring and nail mount, changing the tactile cue the brain uses to judge compliance.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学分别用裸指和戴胶带缠紧的手指按同一块海绵/桌面，评估软硬感差异；变化：配合手机AR显示“软/硬”的视觉提示看是否能强化错觉。

works.title: FeetThrough
works.description: An electrotactile insole renders virtual textures and bumps under the feet while its thin design still lets the wearer feel the real ground.
works.idea_zh: 脚底既能感到虚拟地面，也不丢失真实地面的感觉。
works.technique: Uses thin electrode arrays on the foot's arch and sides to deliver electrotactile patterns without covering the sole's pressure-sensing areas.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个手机GPS/AR“脚下提示”行走路线：到达关键点时通过口袋里的手机振动提示；变化：振动模式模拟不同地面（草地、沙子）。

works.title: Stick&Slip
works.description: Tiny liquid coatings are dispensed onto the fingertip to change friction on the fly, making any real surface feel sticky or slippery in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 往指尖涂一层液体，就能让任何表面变滑或变涩。
works.technique: Pumps small amounts of lubricating or friction-raising liquids onto the fingerpad and removes them, altering finger-surface friction without instrumenting the surface.
works.exercise_zh: 准备护手霜、爽身粉、水三种指尖涂层，让同学摸同一张纸并描述感受，再配合手机AR给纸面换上冰面/沙地贴图；变化：盲测能否猜出涂层。

works.title: ProtoAR
works.description: Designers sketch on paper and shape Play-Doh, capture them with a phone, and immediately place the captured 2D/3D assets in a working mobile AR prototype.
works.idea_zh: 纸上画、橡皮泥捏，拍一下就变成可用的AR原型。
works.technique: Captures sketches as image layers and clay models via multi-angle photos turned into 3D, then streams them into a marker/plane-based AR viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用纸笔画界面、用橡皮泥捏角色，用手机扫描（如Reality Composer/Polycam）后在AR中摆放演示；变化：限定30分钟做出一个AR导览原型。

works.title: 360proto
works.description: Paper sketches drawn on equirectangular 360 grids are photographed and instantly viewed as immersive VR/AR scenes, with layers for interactive prototypes.
works.idea_zh: 在纸上画360度全景草图，拍一下就能在头显里走进去。
works.technique: Maps hand-drawn sketches on a distorted 360 grid template onto a sphere around the viewer, with layered sketches for AR overlays.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张等距柱状投影网格纸让学生画一个房间，拍照后用手机全景查看器浏览；变化：在同一场景中叠加一层“AR标签”草图。

works.title: XRDirector
works.description: A role-based collaborative authoring tool where one person acts as director, others as actors or camera, puppeteering virtual characters in AR together like filming a scene.
works.idea_zh: 像拍电影一样分角色：导演、演员、摄影一起在AR中排演。
works.technique: Synchronises a shared AR scene across devices and assigns each device a role with its own controls for moving characters, cameras and timelines.
works.exercise_zh: 分组用Reality Composer或共享AR App：一人做“导演”喊指令，两人各拿手机操控一个虚拟角色排演一个30秒短剧；变化：最后由“摄影师”手机录屏成片。

works.title: MRAT: Mixed Reality Analytics Toolkit
works.description: A toolkit that logs and visualises how users move, look and interact in mixed reality apps, replaying their paths and gaze as 3D traces in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把用户在MR里走过的路和看过的地方画成空间轨迹。
works.technique: Instruments Unity MR apps to record head pose, gaze and input events and renders them as in-situ 3D heatmaps and trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR记录同学在教室里一次寻宝过程中手机的位置，事后在AR中回放为彩色轨迹线；变化：用颜色表示停留时间，讨论设计问题。

works.title: XRStudio
works.description: A virtual production system for teaching in XR: the instructor's immersive session is mixed with real camera video and live-streamed so remote students can follow.
works.idea_zh: 把老师在XR里的讲课混合成直播画面给学生看。
works.technique: Composites the instructor's tracked XR view with external camera footage and scene cameras into multiple switchable streams.
works.exercise_zh: 用OBS把一名同学手机AR画面和教室摄像头画面合成直播，让他用AR讲解一个3D模型；变化：观众通过弹幕控制AR中模型的颜色。

works.title: Reframe
works.description: An AR storyboarding tool where designers place characters and events in the real space to act out and analyse security and privacy threats of AR apps.
works.idea_zh: 在真实空间里用AR故事板演出隐私威胁场景。
works.technique: Provides placeable character and annotation primitives in AR plus a threat-modelling framework to structure character-driven scenarios.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在教室里摆放“用户/旁观者/攻击者”的虚拟小人，演出一个AR眼镜偷拍场景并讨论如何设计防护；变化：每组为对方的场景设计一个隐私补丁。

works.title: Renegade Projected AR in Downtown Vegas
works.description: A Lightform projector on a cargo bike rides through downtown Las Vegas at night, scanning building facades and instantly mapping animated graphics onto them.
works.idea_zh: 骑着投影自行车，随走随扫描随投影，把城市墙面变成AR壁画。
works.technique: The projector-camera unit projects structured-light patterns to capture a depth/edge map of the facade, then auto-aligns effects to its edges.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机投影仪或小投影机在夜晚对着校园墙面投射预先做好的动画，并用手机拍下墙面照片在Keynote里描边对齐；变化：投影内容必须利用墙上的一个真实裂缝或窗户。

works.title: It's Lit! Projected AR Murals
works.description: Lettering artist Gemma O'Brien and Craig Winslow hand-paint a mural, then Lightform projects animated light that traces, fills and reveals the painted letters.
works.idea_zh: 手绘壁画 + 投影动画，让静态字母“亮”起来。
works.technique: Scans the painted mural to extract its line work, then uses those edges as masks and paths for projected animated effects.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生在白纸板上用黑色马克笔写大字，再用投影仪和免费投影映射软件（如MapMap）沿笔画投射流光；变化：用声音音量控制光的亮度。

works.title: Lightform LF2 and Lightform Creator
works.description: The LF2 projector-camera and Creator software scan a scene of objects and let designers select surfaces and apply animated effects in minutes.
works.idea_zh: 扫描一下场景，就能给每个物体表面选特效。
works.technique: Captures a high-resolution scan from the projector's viewpoint so every pixel of the scan corresponds to a projector pixel, removing manual calibration.
works.exercise_zh: 把几个白色纸盒堆在桌上，用投影仪+OBS/MapMap为每个面分配不同颜色动画；变化：挪动一个盒子后在1分钟内重新对齐。

works.title: NightBloom at the Conservatory of Flowers
works.description: An immersive night event at San Francisco's Conservatory of Flowers where projections wash over living plants and glasshouse structures.
works.idea_zh: 把投影打在真实植物上，让温室在夜里“开花”。
works.technique: Uses scan-based alignment to project organic animated textures onto irregular foliage and architecture.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里把投影打在一盆植物上，投射缓慢变化的色彩和光点；变化：用手机麦克风让植物上的光随说话声“呼吸”。

works.title: Project LFX: Steerable Projected Interfaces
works.description: A pan-and-tilt projector that moves projected interfaces around the room onto tables, walls and objects wherever they are needed.
works.idea_zh: 会转头的投影仪，把界面送到房间里任何表面。
works.technique: Mounts a projector-camera on a motorized pan-tilt head and re-warps content in real time for each target surface in a scanned room model.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机投影仪放在可转动的台灯臂或旋转底座上，手动转动把一个“计时器界面”投到桌面、墙面、门上；变化：用舵机+Arduino让它自动跟随一个人。

works.title: LightGuide
works.description: A ceiling projector draws arrows, color gradients and 3D cues directly on the user's hand to guide it along a precise movement path.
works.idea_zh: 把动作提示直接投影在你的手上，手跟着光走。
works.technique: Tracks the hand with a depth camera and renders movement-guidance visualizations warped onto the hand surface in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪在桌面/手上投射一条动画路径，让同学用手跟随画出一个字母；变化：用手机AR改为在屏幕上把箭头贴在手上，比较两种引导的准确度。

works.title: BeThere
works.description: A mobile 3D collaboration system where a remote user sees a reconstructed 3D copy of the local space and reaches in with tracked hands to point and manipulate.
works.idea_zh: 远程的人把手“伸进”你的空间指指点点。
works.technique: Attaches a depth sensor to a mobile device to capture the scene and the user's hand, sharing both as 3D data so remote hands appear in the local AR view.
works.exercise_zh: 组织两人视频通话：远程者在截图上画圈画箭头，本地者用手机AR把这些标记放到真实物体上完成组装任务；变化：只允许用手势不许说话。

works.title: PenLight
works.description: A digital pen with a built-in mini projector overlays digital content, such as building floor-plan layers, directly onto the paper where you are writing.
works.idea_zh: 笔尖自带投影，写在纸上的同时把数字图层投在纸上。
works.technique: Tracks the pen's position on dot-pattern paper and projects spatially registered overlays around the pen tip.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机投影仪对准一张打印的平面图，从上方投射“隐藏的水管/电路层”，学生用笔描出；变化：用手机AR替代投影，比较手持与投影的体验。

works.title: YouMove
works.description: An AR mirror records an expert's movement and then trains learners by overlaying skeleton guides and feedback on their mirror reflection, gradually removing guidance.
works.idea_zh: AR魔镜把老师的动作叠在你的镜像上，一步步教你跳。
works.technique: Uses Kinect skeleton tracking behind a large half-silvered mirror to draw recorded motion guides aligned with the user's reflection and score their accuracy.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前摄+人体姿态识别（如MediaPipe/Effect House）叠加一个“老师骨架”，学生跟着做一套广播操并获得评分；变化：逐步淡化骨架直到完全隐藏。

works.title: Ivy: Spatially Situated Visual Programming
works.description: In VR/AR, users see the sensors and actuators of a smart environment where they physically are and wire them together with visual-programming links in space.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间里用连线把灯、传感器“编程”起来。
works.technique: Anchors node-graph widgets to each device's physical location and lets users draw dataflow connections between them in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 给教室里的灯、门、窗贴二维码，用手机AR显示它们的“节点”，学生画线组合“门开→灯亮”的规则（可用Home自动化模拟）；变化：规则由两人合作一个画输入一个画输出。

works.title: HydroRing
works.description: A thin ring pumps warm, cold or pulsing liquid through a latex tube on the fingertip to create pressure, vibration and temperature cues while leaving touch of real objects intact.
works.idea_zh: 用流动的液体在指尖产生冷热和压感，又不妨碍摸真实物体。
works.technique: Drives liquid through a thin tube over the fingerpad with pumps and heaters, modulating flow and temperature to render haptic effects.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学手指分别接触冷水袋和温水袋，同时在手机AR中看到“冰块/火焰”，讨论视觉与触觉一致时的真实感；变化：故意让视觉与温度相反。

works.title: AuthAR
works.description: While an expert assembles furniture, the system records video and 3D tracking to author an AR assembly tutorial at the same time, which learners then follow in a headset.
works.idea_zh: 边组装边自动生成AR教程。
works.technique: Combines object tracking with synchronized video capture so each assembly step becomes a spatially anchored AR instruction with clips and annotations.
works.exercise_zh: 分成两人一组：一人组装乐高时用手机录制每一步，另一人用Reality Composer把每步视频/箭头放在对应零件位置上，给第三人使用；变化：教程不许用文字。

works.title: Loki
works.description: A bi-directional mixed-reality telepresence system where teacher and learner can each switch between video, 3D capture and virtual-replica views to demonstrate physical tasks.
works.idea_zh: 师生双向混合现实远程教学，可在视频、3D和虚拟复本间切换。
works.technique: Streams RGB-D point clouds of both spaces and lets either user record, annotate and replay 3D demonstrations inside the other's environment.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建两间教室间的视频通话+手机AR远程折纸课：老师的手部动作录成短视频挂在学生AR桌面上；变化：学生也能回传自己的错误动作让老师标注。

works.title: Tactum
works.description: Touch and pinch gestures on your own forearm are tracked and a projector shows a live 3D-printable wearable form growing on your skin as you design it.
works.idea_zh: 在自己的手臂上用手势“捏”出一件可3D打印的饰品。
works.technique: Tracks the arm with a depth camera, interprets skin touches as modelling gestures and projection-maps the resulting geometry back onto the arm.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手部追踪在手臂上放置可拉伸的虚拟手镯，并用手势调整形状后导出截图做纸模；变化：投影仪从上方把设计投在真实手臂上。

works.title: ExoSkin
works.description: A hybrid fabrication system for designing and 3D-printing wearables directly on the body, combining on-body modelling with printing onto a body-shaped surface.
works.idea_zh: 直接在身体上设计并打印可穿戴物。
works.technique: Scans the body part, lets the designer model around it in 3D, and prints the wearable in place on a body-shaped form.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机扫描同学的手腕（Polycam等），在3D软件里围绕模型画一条饰带并用纸条按比例还原；变化：在AR中先试戴再制作。

works.title: Interactive Focus and Context Visualization for AR
works.description: A magic-lens style AR view that reveals hidden internal parts of a real object (e.g. a car engine) while preserving key edges of the outside for depth cues.
works.idea_zh: 像透视镜一样看见物体内部，同时保留外壳轮廓帮你判断深度。
works.technique: Renders hidden virtual structure inside a focus region and composites real-world edges extracted from the video as context to keep occlusion cues.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在一个真实纸盒上叠加“内部结构”3D模型，并用描边保留盒子外轮廓，对比有无轮廓时的深度感；变化：让透视区域跟随手指移动。

works.title: Adaptive Ghosted Views for AR
works.description: Ghosted X-ray views that adapt which real-world features to keep visible, so hidden pipes or rooms behind a wall stay readable without losing the wall.
works.idea_zh: 自适应的“幽灵透视”：墙后管线可见，墙本身也不消失。
works.technique: Computes importance from real-world image features and adapts the transparency of the occluder per pixel before revealing the hidden virtual layer.
works.exercise_zh: 给一面贴有海报的墙做AR“看穿墙”效果：把海报的主要线条保留为半透明，后面显示虚拟管道；变化：让同学评估保留多少细节最好。

works.title: Dynamic Compact Visualizations for AR
works.description: AR annotations and exploded views of a real object are laid out compactly and reorganise dynamically as the viewpoint changes, avoiding clutter.
works.idea_zh: AR标注和爆炸图随视角自动重新排布，永不杂乱。
works.technique: Uses view-management optimisation to cluster and position labels and explosion diagrams in screen space each frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR为一台拆开的旧电器零件加标签，让同学设计标签在转动视角时如何避免重叠；变化：只允许显示3个标签，其余折叠。

works.title: Retargeting Technical Documentation to AR
works.description: Printed instruction manuals are automatically converted into 3D AR instructions: the arrows and steps from paper diagrams are mapped onto the real device.
works.idea_zh: 把纸质说明书自动变成叠在实物上的AR步骤。
works.technique: Parses manual illustrations, registers them to a 3D model of the device, and re-renders arrows and motion cues in AR on the tracked real object.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一份宜家说明书的一页，学生用Reality Composer把其中的箭头和零件动画放到真实物件上；变化：比较纸质与AR版本谁装得更快。

works.title: Retargeting Video Tutorials to AR
works.description: Tool paths in video tutorials (e.g. painting or sanding strokes on a surface) are extracted and replayed as 3D AR guides on the user's own object.
works.idea_zh: 把视频教程里的工具动作抽出来，变成叠在自己物体上的AR轨迹。
works.technique: Tracks the tool and its surface contact in the source video, reconstructs the 3D path, and renders it as animated guides registered to the target surface.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段书法或描线教学视频，手动描出其中的笔画路径，用手机AR叠加在学生自己的纸上跟写；变化：路径速度随学生书写速度自适应。

works.title: Mixed Reality Light Fields for Remote Assistance
works.description: A local worker captures a light field of a workspace with a phone; the remote expert explores it with free viewpoints and places annotations that appear in the worker's AR view.
works.idea_zh: 用手机拍下光场，远程专家自由看角度并把标注放回现场AR。
works.technique: Captures many registered images to render novel views of the scene for the remote helper, then anchors their 3D annotations back in the local tracking space.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生甲用手机从多个角度拍一个桌面故障（如接线），学生乙在照片上标注步骤，甲再用AR标签还原到现场；变化：限定乙只能看3张照片。

works.title: Whale in the Gym (concept)
works.description: A humpback whale bursts out of a school gym floor in front of students and splashes back down, a concept film for shared, room-scale mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 一头鲸鱼从学校体育馆地板里跃出。
works.technique: Concept visualization (likely VFX compositing rather than live headset capture) of a large creature breaking through a real floor plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR（如Reality Composer）让一个巨大动物从教室地板“冲出”，并设计一个遮挡的洞口效果；变化：全班同时用多部手机看到同一只动物。

works.title: Magic Leap Create
works.description: A mixed-reality toy box: place dinosaurs, knights, dominoes and paint strokes in your room, and they fight, topple and bounce off real furniture.
works.idea_zh: 在客厅里摆放恐龙、骑士和多米诺，它们会与真实家具互动。
works.technique: Uses the headset's world mesh as a physics collider so user-placed toys and strokes land on, bounce off and hide behind real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR的平面检测+物理（Reality Composer或Unity AR Foundation）搭一条跨越桌子和地面的虚拟多米诺；变化：必须利用一个真实物体作为机关。

works.title: Dodge (developer sample)
works.description: Rock golems rise out of your real floor and hurl boulders that you physically dodge while swatting others away with hand gestures.
works.idea_zh: 石头怪从真实地板里钻出来扔石头，你要真的躲。
works.technique: Spawns characters on detected floor meshes and uses head position as the target so the player's real body movement is the core mechanic.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR做一个躲避游戏：虚拟球从地面某点向手机飞来，玩家需要移动身体躲开；变化：两名玩家互相为对方放置发射点。

works.title: Mica
works.description: A photoreal digital human sits at your real table, makes eye contact, reacts to your gaze and shares small moments without speaking.
works.idea_zh: 一个会和你对视、坐在你真实桌旁的数字人。
works.technique: Drives the character's gaze and expressions from the user's tracked eye direction and anchors her to detected table and chair surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR放置一个虚拟角色，使其头部始终转向手机镜头（LookAt），让同学体验被注视的感觉；变化：角色只在你不看它时移动。

works.title: Undersea
works.description: A living coral reef appears in your room; fish swim around your furniture and respond as you reach toward them with your hands.
works.idea_zh: 把一片会回应你手的珊瑚礁搬进房间。
works.technique: Places a reef ecosystem on meshed surfaces and uses hand tracking to trigger flocking-avoidance behaviours in the fish.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在地板放一片虚拟珊瑚和鱼群，鱼群会躲避手机靠近（距离检测）；变化：用手机手电筒光照吸引鱼群聚集。

works.title: Lost Droids (MR test)
works.description: Shot through Magic Leap optics: R2-D2 and C-3PO appear in a real office, R2 projects a hologram message and the droids react to the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 星战机器人出现在真实办公室里并向你投射全息信息。
works.technique: Real-time rendered characters anchored to the physical room and filmed directly through the prototype's optics.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR让一个角色在教室里“投射”一段录好的视频留言（在角色上方播放视频平面）；变化：留言只在两人同时观看时播放。

works.title: Star Wars: Project Porg
works.description: Adopt porgs that waddle around your real home, recognise surfaces and play fetch with you on Magic Leap.
works.idea_zh: 把星战里的Porg当宠物养在家里。
works.technique: Character behaviour trees query the room mesh for walkable surfaces and toys so the pets navigate and play in the real space.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR做一个会在桌面上跟随手机移动、捡球的小宠物（导航网格或简单跟随脚本）；变化：宠物会记住你上次放玩具的位置。

works.title: Minecraft for HoloLens (E3 demo)
works.description: On stage at E3, a player sees a Minecraft world built on a real coffee table, zooms into it, opens it like a dollhouse and commands it by voice.
works.idea_zh: 把整个Minecraft世界放在真实茶几上，用语音和手势操控。
works.technique: Anchors a scaled game world to a detected table surface and combines gaze, air-tap and voice for world manipulation.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR把一个方块小世界放在桌面上，并用语音指令（如iOS快捷指令或Web Speech）“爆炸/下雨”；变化：让观众在另一部手机上看到同一世界。

works.title: RoboRaid
works.description: Alien robots burst through your actual walls, leaving cracks, and you shoot them with gaze and air-tap while physically dodging projectiles.
works.idea_zh: 外星机器人从你家真实墙壁破墙而入。
works.technique: Uses the spatial-mapping mesh to pick wall spawn points and render crack decals, with spatial audio signalling enemies behind the player.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测竖直墙面并在墙上生成“破洞”贴图和钻出的敌人，玩家用准星点击射击；变化：只用声音提示敌人方位。

works.title: HoloStudio
works.description: Build 3D models in 3D with holographic tools modelled on real ones, then send them to a 3D printer to become physical objects.
works.idea_zh: 用手势在空中搭建3D模型，再打印成实物。
works.technique: Provides a toolbelt of primitive shapes and holographic tools manipulated with gaze and air-tap, exporting printable meshes.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR（如Reality Composer）拼搭一个桌面雕塑，截图导出后用纸板/黏土做实体版本；变化：规定只能使用三种基本形状。

works.title: The World Beyond
works.description: A Presence Platform showcase where you shine a flashlight to dissolve your real walls into an alien world and play with Oppy, a pet that responds to hand gestures and voice.
works.idea_zh: 用“手电”把真实墙壁溶解成外星世界，还有一只听你话的宠物。
works.technique: Uses the Scene model to know wall planes, then masks passthrough with a shader where the virtual flashlight hits, revealing the VR world behind.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测墙面，在手机指向处挖出一个圆形“洞”显示另一个世界（遮罩着色器或Portal组件）；变化：洞只在你说出咒语时打开。

works.title: First Encounters
works.description: Fluffy aliens attack after your ship crashes into your room; you shoot holes through your real walls to see space outside and chase aliens through them.
works.idea_zh: 打穿自家墙壁，看见外面的外星空间。
works.technique: Scans the room into a scene mesh, then replaces passthrough with a virtual exterior wherever the player's shots break wall segments.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测墙面，被点击的地方贴出“破洞”并透出一张太空全景；变化：破洞越多，房间里的“外星生物”越多。

works.title: SwiftShot
works.description: A WWDC multiplayer ARKit 2 game: players on several iPhones/iPads see the same tabletop battlefield and fling slingshot projectiles at each other's wooden blocks.
works.idea_zh: 多人在同一张桌子上的共享AR弹弓大战。
works.technique: Shares an ARWorldMap between devices so all players relocalize to the same anchors, then syncs physics state over peer-to-peer networking.
works.exercise_zh: 用Reality Composer或AR Foundation共享锚点做两人对战：在同一张桌面上用手机轻扫发射小球撞倒对方积木；变化：桌面上的真实杯子作为不可穿透的障碍。

works.title: Encounter Dinosaurs
works.description: On Vision Pro a portal opens in your wall; a butterfly lands on your outstretched finger and dinosaurs step toward you, reacting when you move or reach out.
works.idea_zh: 墙上开出一扇门，恐龙探头出来和你互动，蝴蝶停在你的指尖。
works.technique: Renders a portal into a full environment anchored to a wall and drives creature behaviours from the user's head and hand positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在墙上放一个门户，里面的角色会随手机靠近而后退或前进；变化：伸出手（手部检测）时让一只虚拟蝴蝶停在手上。

works.title: The Floor Is Lava!
works.description: Using Figmin XR on Quest 3, the real living-room floor is covered with bubbling virtual lava while furniture remains safe islands.
works.idea_zh: 把客厅地板变成岩浆，只有家具是安全岛。
works.technique: Places a lava material on the detected floor plane while the scene mesh keeps real furniture visible and occluding.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测地面铺满岩浆材质，并让玩家只能踩在贴有标记的“安全垫”上（图片识别）；变化：岩浆每30秒上涨一次。

works.title: The Real World Is Your Canvas
works.description: An artist paints glowing strokes and objects around a real room in Figmin XR; the art wraps around furniture and stays anchored in place.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间的家具间作画，画作永远留在原处。
works.technique: Combines 3D brush strokes with persistent spatial anchors so drawings stay registered to the room between sessions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR绘画App（如Just a Line的继任或Reality Composer）在教室某个角落画3D装置并保存锚点，下节课重新打开；变化：两人在同一锚点上接力完成作品。

works.title: Figmin XR: Create, Collect & Play
works.description: The app's trailer: users sketch, import 3D models, animate and play physics-driven creations that bounce off the real room in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 在混合现实里创作、收藏并玩你的3D作品。
works.technique: Integrates sketching, model import, animation and a physics engine that uses the room mesh as colliders.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR导入同学各自扫描的小物件模型，在桌上组成一个“混合现实收藏馆”并让它们受物理影响掉落；变化：每件作品配一段语音介绍。

works.title: AI-scripted Playable Character
works.description: A cute robot character that walks, runs, jumps and emotes around a real room, with its behaviour written entirely by AI through Figmin's scripting API.
works.idea_zh: 用AI写脚本，让一个小机器人在你房间里跑跳玩耍。
works.technique: An LLM generates Lua-style scripts against the app's API that drive character animation states and collisions with the room mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用ChatGPT生成一个Unity/Reality Composer行为脚本，使AR小角色在桌上巡逻并在碰到真实杯子时跳起；变化：用自然语言临时修改角色性格。

works.title: Mixed Reality RC Airplane
works.description: An AI-generated model airplane, coded entirely by an LLM, flies around the living room under the player's control and collides with real walls.
works.idea_zh: AI生成的遥控飞机在客厅里飞行，会撞上真实墙壁。
works.technique: Uses the room mesh as colliders and an LLM-written flight script mapping controller input to lift, thrust and roll.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机陀螺仪控制AR中的纸飞机在教室飞行，撞到检测到的墙面就坠落；变化：设置穿过真实门框的“环”作为赛道。

works.title: Dialogue with Great Souls
works.description: A street exhibition on Daxue Road, Shanghai with Soul App: scan a code, place an AR 'Anywhere Door' anywhere and step through into a scene to converse with eight historical sages.
works.idea_zh: 在街头放下一扇AR任意门，穿过去与古代先贤对话。
works.technique: A phone AR portal with stencil masking hides the inner scene until the user walks through the door plane, anchored at user-chosen positions along the street.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR做一扇任意门，门后是你选的一位历史人物的场景和一段语音，穿门才能听到；变化：门只能放在校园里与该人物有关的地点。

works.title: FungiSync
works.description: A mixed-reality participatory ritual: participants wear mushroom-decorated MR masks and exchange 'worldviews' through secret handshakes, blending each other's visual filters like a mycorrhizal network.
works.idea_zh: 戴上蘑菇面具，用握手交换彼此眼中的世界。
works.technique: Likely co-located phone-based MR headsets share an anchor and detect handshake gestures to swap and mix each participant's visual shader.
works.exercise_zh: 让每组同学各做一个手机AR滤镜代表自己的“世界观”，两人击掌（靠近检测或扫码）后交换滤镜；变化：三人以上相遇时滤镜混合。

works.title: Body Oracle Translator
works.description: A handheld MR device translates people's body postures in real time into speculative AI-generated hieroglyphs inspired by Chinese oracle-bone script.
works.idea_zh: 把身体姿态实时翻译成AI生成的“甲骨文”。
works.technique: Classifies body poses with a pose-estimation model and maps them to a pre-generated glyph set rendered as AR overlays next to the person.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机人体姿态识别（Effect House/MediaPipe）把5种姿势映射成5个自创象形字，拍照时叠在人旁边；变化：连续姿势拼成一句“身体句子”。

works.title: Foldiverse
works.description: An MR origami trainer for autistic children: a virtual 3D origami model and a voice assistant called FoFo guide each fold step-by-step over the real paper.
works.idea_zh: AR折纸老师一步步引导孩子折纸。
works.technique: Shows animated 3D fold steps registered near the child's paper with voice prompts from an assistant, advancing when a step is complete.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在桌面上播放一步一步的3D折纸动画，并用语音按钮进入下一步；变化：让手机识别纸张形状自动判断是否完成当前步骤。

works.title: Inside[JOB]
works.description: JobBot leaps into your real room on Android XR; you fix quirky system settings, 'phish' for data and stream updates in playful hand-tracked mini-jobs across MR and VR.
works.idea_zh: JobBot机器人闯进你的真实房间，用双手完成搞笑的小工作。
works.technique: Uses high-fidelity hand tracking with physics-based grabbing so every virtual prop can be poked, pulled and thrown in passthrough space.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手势识别做三个“荒诞小工作”（捏住虚拟插头插到真实插座旁、拍打故障屏幕等）；变化：每个任务只能用一只手完成。

works.title: Wall Town Wonders
works.description: A Quest 3 mixed-reality town builder: tiny houses, streets and townsfolk grow out of your real walls, and you tend to their wishes by hand.
works.idea_zh: 在自家墙面上建一座会生活的小镇。
works.technique: Uses scene-understanding wall planes as the build grid so buildings attach to vertical surfaces and characters walk along them.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR竖直平面检测在教室墙上放置小房子和小人，小人沿墙“行走”；变化：墙上的真实窗户或海报成为小镇的地标。

works.title: HoloKit Drone Attack
works.description: Two players wearing HoloKit cardboard headsets share one living room and shoot down virtual drones together in stereo AR, shown at SIGGRAPH 2017.
works.idea_zh: 两人戴纸盒AR头显，在同一房间合作打无人机。
works.technique: Both phones start from the same physical position and orientation to share a coordinate frame, then sync game state with UNet.
works.exercise_zh: 让两名同学各用手机（可放入HoloKit或纸盒）从同一起点启动AR，合作射击同一批虚拟目标；变化：一人只能看见目标，另一人只能射击。

works.title: HoloKit 4DViews Rocker Hologram
works.description: A volumetric-captured rock guitarist performs life-size in the room through a HoloKit stereo headset, viewable from any angle.
works.idea_zh: 真人体积视频摇滚歌手在你房间里演出。
works.technique: Plays back a sequence of textured meshes from volumetric capture anchored on the floor and rendered stereoscopically.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍摄同学的一段短表演做成透明背景视频（抠像），放入AR场景作为“全息演出”；变化：多个同学的表演组成一支AR乐队。

works.title: Practice Makes Perfect (North Star)
works.description: On the Project North Star headset a player uses a real table and paddle; a hand gesture summons a virtual ball, an AI opponent returns it, and predicted flight paths and light trails coach the player's form.
works.idea_zh: 真实球台和球拍，虚拟的球和AI对手，外加预测轨迹帮你练球。
works.technique: Tracks the paddle and hands, simulates the virtual ball with parabolic equations of motion, and renders predicted trajectories with the headset's low latency and wide field of view.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在桌面上标出一个“最佳落点”靶区，同学抛纸团命中时计分；变化：靶区随每次命中移动，并显示上一球的轨迹。

works.title: HoloKit + Tango Demo
works.description: An early test of HoloKit's cardboard stereo optics driven by a Google Tango phone, placing stable holograms in the room.
works.idea_zh: 用纸盒头显+Tango手机实现早期空间稳定的立体AR。
works.technique: Uses Tango's motion tracking for 6DoF pose and renders a side-by-side stereo image through HoloKit's mirror-and-Fresnel optics.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机AR场景改为左右分屏立体渲染，放入纸盒眼镜观看一个固定在桌上的方块；变化：比较单眼画面与立体画面的深度感。

leads.name: Jun Rekimoto
leads.why: Co-author of JackIn / JackIn Head; pioneer of NaviCam, CyberCode and Sony CSL AR (pre- and post-2005 work); University of Tokyo Rekimoto Lab.

leads.name: Satoru Higa (BACKSPACE Productions)
leads.why: Visual artist co-creating Fragment Shadow multi-projector shadow art with Kasahara.

leads.name: Jun Nishida
leads.why: EMS and body-sharing researcher (Wired Muscle, Preemptive Action, bioSync); now University of Maryland.

leads.name: Daniel Leithinger
leads.why: THING Lab (CU Boulder); shape displays for remote togetherness; core works already under MIT Tangible Media, newer lab work needs AR-specific videos.

leads.name: Sean Follmer
leads.why: Stanford SHAPE Lab (shapeShift, zooids swarm UI, visuo-haptic illusions); mostly VR/tangible, few AR pieces.

leads.name: Hirokazu Kato
leads.why: ARToolKit creator (NAIST); post-2005 videos found are mainly talks, not demos.

leads.name: Jason Orlosky
leads.why: Co-author of Laplacian Vision; AR vision-augmentation and gaze-based interaction researcher.

leads.name: Kiyoshi Kiyokawa
leads.why: NAIST Cybernetics & Reality Engineering Lab; occlusion-capable OST displays and vision augmentation with Itoh.

leads.name: Balasaravanan Thoravi Kumaravel
leads.why: Loki / TutoriVR / TransceiVR mixed-reality instruction tools (Berkeley, Autodesk, now Microsoft Research).

leads.name: Peter Mohr
leads.why: TU Graz; lead author of Retargeting Technical Documentation / Video Tutorials to AR and MR light-field remote assistance.

leads.name: Stefanie Zollmann
leads.why: University of Otago; X-ray/ghosting visualization, AR for sports broadcast and drones.

leads.name: Craig Winslow
leads.why: Light artist; renegade projected-AR murals with Lightform (Vegas, 'It's Lit').

leads.name: Gemma O'Brien
leads.why: Lettering artist collaborating on projected AR murals with Lightform.

leads.name: Noah Zerkin / CombineReality
leads.why: Builds open-source Project North Star AR headset kits (Deck X); mostly hardware videos, few experience demos.

leads.name: Tim Stutts
leads.why: Former Magic Leap interaction/sensory design lead; public output is talks, not project videos.

leads.name: Martin Schubert
leads.why: Leap Motion designer; public pieces (Weightless, Mirrors) are VR, AR work credited under leap-motion-design.

leads.name: Onix Systems
leads.why: Early HoloKit X Unity demos (wizard duel, dragon duel) - co-located AR collaboration.

leads.name: Wingnut AR (Peter Jackson)
leads.why: WWDC 2017 ARKit tabletop battle demo and Magic Leap 'Grordbort's' collaborators; still unresearched.

leads.name: PRELOADED (BBC Earth Micro Kingdoms)
leads.why: Made 'Micro Kingdoms: Senses' on Magic Leap - see the world through animal senses.

leads.name: Ke Huang / Ruoqi Wang
leads.why: Co-authors of Body Oracle Translator with Danlin Huang and Botao Amber Hu.
